p.title: v59.98 The 시장 상태 story and the rates axis quote one 10-year 5-session change when the 10-year lags
p.symptom: With the 10-year input behind the S&P 500 close, the 시장 상태 story printed a different 10-year 5-session change than the verdict table's rates axis (plan 035 replay: -9bp vs -7bp; a local replay with the last two tnx values removed: -9bp vs -3bp).
p.root_cause: The story measured the 10-year from the close five US sessions before the S&P 500 basis to the 10-year's last close, a shorter window when that close lags; the axis counts five sessions back from the 10-year's own last close.
p.fix: market-story.js reads the 10-year through closeChange (the shared window owner, same sessionPointBack as the axis) ending at the 10-year's own last close on or before the basis, only while alignInput accepts it; the FRED real/breakeven legs split that same window.
p.violated_rule: One metric, one window, one number on every screen.
p.prevention: ci-esm-core-unit-check builds a synthetic history with the 10-year two sessions behind and asserts the story and the rates axis quote the same 5-session change dated by the 10-year's close.
p.verification: The new check failed before the fix (axis +15bp, story +9bp) and passes after; ci-metric-consistency-check, ci-domain-parity-check and ci-data-audit-contract-check pass.

changelog: **10년 금리 5거래일 변화 한 창 ({P}):** 10년 금리 자료가 S&P 500 종가보다 늦을 때도 시장 상태 이야기가 판정표 금리 축과 같은 5거래일 변화(10년 금리 자체의 마지막 종가 기준)를 인용한다.
